title: Do-not-drink advisory
tldr: Use commercially bottled or officially approved water for drinking, cooking, brushing teeth, ice, formula and pets. Do not try to make chemically contaminated water safe by boiling. Read the notice for which other uses are allowed.
steps: Check what contaminant is involved and which uses are prohibited.
Use the approved alternative for anything swallowed or used to prepare food.
Bathing, laundry and cleaning depend on the exact local notice.
Follow any flushing or filter replacement instructions before resuming use.
next: Save the utility notice and alternative-water distribution location offline.
watch: Clear appearance and normal taste cannot confirm safety.
review_status: source-linked editorial review; not independent expert certification
without_help: Set aside sealed water for drinking, food and medicines, including pet needs. Mark the unsafe taps so nobody uses them by habit. If you have no trusted update, keep using the safer supply; restored pressure or clear appearance does not establish safety.
household: Write down water, food, battery and medication needs for each person. Keep clean and dirty containers separate and preserve essential power before entertainment. Agree on the point at which lack of water, medical support or safe temperature means you must relocate.
pack_now: Keep essential medicines, drinking water, a battery light, shoes, phone power and a written contact card within reach. Adapt the load to the hazard and the people with you; do not delay escape to collect equipment.
